The 3 Chinese books can be ordered in \(3! = 6\) ways.

To keep all Chinese books non-adjacent, the mathematics books must occupy both internal gaps between consecutive Chinese books. The third mathematics book can go in either the first or last gap, giving 2 valid gap choices.

The 3 mathematics books can be ordered in \(3! = 6\) ways.

Total:
